hypotheses: In the loop list, the debug loop is one row per problem iaso is fixing itself: the symptom in plain words as what is to be achieved, where its fix stands (open, fix being written, tests, landed, checked live) and what is left before it is fixed. A problem that needs the owner says so. A resolved problem is not listed.

given a problem whose fix is written and whose tests are running, when the loops are listed, then its row gives the symptom in plain words, the fix written and the tests running, and landing and the live check as left
given a problem whose fix is in main and not yet checked live, when the loops are listed, then its row reads landed, not checked live, with the live check left
given a problem iaso could not put right, ending as a defect report or a question to the owner, when the loops are listed, then its row says it waits for the owner
given a problem resolved and proven, when the loops are listed, then it is not listed
